name: Death (as a player)
note: Polygons in the rest pose (A1) pixels. Death at three-quarter, as a player: the finale's right-hand chair (mirrored), and later an online avatar (cosmetic loops only, rule 3). The master is the rest pose's OWN head; the jaw talks (face sheet pieces 2-4). Every pose but rest a whole-figure frame with its own drawn head. No prop.

what.A1: Rest: forearms on the table's edge, bone hands apart
what.A3: Check: one bone finger taps the felt
what.A4: Call: right hand pushes forward along the felt
what.A5: Bet: leans in, right hand pushed well forward
what.A6: Fold: a weary flick of the fingers
what.B1: All in: both hands push forward together
what.B2: Show: right hand turns palm up
what.B3: Big win: arms opened wide, palms up, a host welcoming guests (`win_big`)
what.B4: Crushing loss: hood bowed, a hand over the brow (`lose_big`)
what.B5: Heads up: elbows on the table, fingers steepled
what.B6: Talking: right hand raised, palm open, jaw dropped
what.C1: LOOP: draws the hood forward with both hands
what.C2: LOOP: turns the gold skull brooch between two fingers
what.C3: LOOP: brushes grey ash from his sleeve
what.C4: LOOP: settles the robe on his shoulders, a small shrug (also a lost pot)
what.C5: LOOP: flexes his bone fingers one by one
what.C6: LOOP: looks up and aside, as at a clock nobody else can see

rest.what: his right forearm in its sleeve and the bone hand
his left forearm in its sleeve and the bone hand
